name: houshiar
description: AI coding assistant powered by your own Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages provider (Houshiar v1).

Hooshyar: View MCP Servers & Tools Status

Hooshyar: Inline Chat (ویرایش مستقیم در کد)
Hooshyar: Explain Terminal Error / Selection (تحلیل خطای ترمینال)

hooshyar.apiFormat.description: API protocol format: 'anthropic' for Anthropic /v1/messages, 'openai' for OpenAI /v1/chat/completions.

hooshyar.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your custom provider (e.g. https://wqai.morvism.ir or https://api.openai.com/v1). Endpoint path (/v1/messages or /v1/chat/completions) is handled according to apiFormat.

hooshyar.apiKey.description: API key for your provider, if it requires one. Prefer setting this via the 'Hooshyar: Open Settings' command, which stores it in Secret Storage instead of settings.json.

hooshyar.model.description: Model string to send in the 'model' field of each request. Depends on what your router accepts/maps.

hooshyar.enableTools.description: Allow the assistant to read/write files and list directories in your workspace via tool_use.

hooshyar.maxAgentTurns.description: Maximum number of autonomous tool execution turns the agent can execute in one request (Plan Mode).

hooshyar.commandTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for foreground run_command executions.

hooshyar.contextInputBudgetTokens.description: Token budget used by the context engine for workspace and attachment context.

hooshyar.experimental.semanticSearch.description: Enable incremental code indexing and the hybrid semantic_search agent tool.

hooshyar.mcpServers.description: MCP servers as a JSON object or JSON string. Stdio servers require command and optional args, env, cwd, disabled; remote servers use url and optional headers.

hooshyar.figmaProxyEnabled.description: Route remote Figma OAuth and MCP requests through the configured proxy.

hooshyar.figmaProxyUrl.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL used only for remote Figma requests.

hooshyar.skills.description: Standalone workspace-relative Markdown/SKILL.md files that provide reusable domain expertise independently from MCP tools.

hooshyar.enableShellTool.description: Allow the assistant to run terminal commands in your workspace (runs with YOUR permissions - review carefully before enabling).

hooshyar.requireApprovalForWrites.description: Ask for confirmation before the assistant writes or edits any file.

hooshyar.requireApprovalForCommands.description: Ask for confirmation before the assistant runs a shell command in the terminal.

hooshyar.autoApproveCommands.description: Automatically approve terminal command execution without asking for manual confirmation.

hooshyar.autoApproveMode.description: Auto-approve file changes without confirmation. 'off': always ask (default), 'safe': auto-approve small edits in current file, 'all': auto-approve all changes (use with caution!).

hooshyar.autoApproveSizeLimit.description: Maximum file size (bytes) for auto-approval in 'safe' mode. Larger changes will still require manual approval.

hooshyar.autoIncludeActiveFile.description: Automatically attach the currently open editor file (or current selection, if any) as context on every message, without needing to ask the assistant to read it.

hooshyar.maxCodebaseFiles.description: Safety cap on how many files the list_codebase / search_codebase tools will scan in one call.

hooshyar.enableInlineCompletions.description: Enable Copilot-style inline ghost text suggestions in the editor (disabled by default to prevent unwanted background token consumption).

hooshyar.inlineContextChars.description: Maximum number of surrounding characters sent to the model for each inline completion request.

hooshyar.inlineTemperature.description: Temperature used for inline completions. Lower values produce more deterministic suggestions.

hooshyar.toolProtocol.description: How tool calls are sent to the provider. auto: native Anthropic tools when supported, otherwise flatten to text. native: always send tools array. text: never send native tools (best for gateways that only understand textual tool tags).

hooshyar.maxRetries.description: Number of retries for failed API requests (network/5xx).

hooshyar.requestTimeoutMs.description: Abort API requests after this many milliseconds.

hooshyar.maxContextChars.description: Approximate character budget for chat history sent to the model (older turns are trimmed to save tokens).

hooshyar.pruneOldToolOutputs.description: Compact large tool outputs from older turns in history to save up to 80% tokens on multi-turn chats.

hooshyar.experimentalAutoCompact.description: Experimental: automatically summarize older conversation turns near the context limit while preserving recent messages and tool calls.

hooshyar.enablePromptCaching.description: Enable Anthropic Prompt Caching for 90% discount on cached system prompts and tool definitions.

hooshyar.maxFileSizeBytes.description: Maximum file size (bytes) read_file / search_codebase will load.

hooshyar.maxWriteSizeBytes.description: Maximum file size (bytes) write_file will accept.

hooshyar.respectIgnoreFiles.description: Skip files matched by .gitignore / .cursorignore when listing or searching the codebase.

hooshyar.showDiffBeforeWrite.description: Open a diff view of proposed file changes before asking for write approval.

hooshyar.openDiffOnEdit.description: Automatically open VS Code's native diff editor when Hooshyar edits or modifies an existing file.

hooshyar.debugLogging.description: Write verbose debug logs to the Hooshyar output channel.

hooshyar.extraHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers as JSON object, e.g. {"X-Custom-Header":"value"}.

hooshyar.allowedShellCommands.description: When run_command is enabled, only commands whose executable name is in this list are allowed (unless the full command matches an entry).

hooshyar.useRipgrep.description: Use ripgrep (rg) for search_codebase when available.

hooshyar.rulesPaths.description: Extra rule files relative to workspace root (also loads .cursorrules, .cursor/rules/*.md, .hooshyar/rules.md).

hooshyar.includeGitDiff.description: Include git diff summary in message context.

hooshyar.includeSymbolOutline.description: Include active file symbol outline in message context.

hooshyar.inlineModel.description: Fast and cheap model for inline completions (defaults to claude-3-5-haiku to save tokens instead of Sonnet).

hooshyar.inlineDebounceMs.description: Debounce delay before requesting inline completions (higher delay saves tokens while typing).

hooshyar.inlineSkipComments.description: Skip inline completions inside comments or strings.

hooshyar.maxImageSizeBytes.description: Maximum image attachment size in bytes (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP).

hooshyar.enableCodeLens.description: Show inline code actions (Ask, Explain, Test, Refactor) above functions and classes.

hooshyar.codeLensMaxItems.description: Maximum number of CodeLens items to show per file (performance limit).
